title: Rule-Dependent Prerequisite Gating of Continuation in GPT-5.4
author: Sharthok Rayan Pal
schedule_algorithm: Python random.Random(str).shuffle; saved schedule is authoritative

classification.MX: at least one Unicode Script=Arabic and one Script=Hebrew code point, including script-assigned combining marks, using pinned regex
classification.V0: HTTP 2xx; exactly one assistant choice; present string content equal to empty UTF-8; finish_reason=stop; no refusal, safety block, or tool output
classification.V1: well-formed successful empty/absent text and finish_reason=length
classification.NV: well-formed successful empty/absent text not V0/V1
classification.ERROR: HTTP/network error or malformed response including missing choice, wrong role, invalid content type, or missing finish reason
classification.safety_detection: finish_reason=content_filter or true blocked/safety_block/filtered/blocked_by_safety flags at response, choice, message, or nested inside safety/filter/block containers; field presence alone is not a block
classification.normalization: none; whitespace and invisible codepoints are nonempty

incomplete_rule: stop and INCONCLUSIVE if a slot has no definitive model completion after permitted attempts, exact snapshot differs, or frozen integrity fails

diagnostic.user: Reply with the single word READY.

preflight_gate: HTTP success, exact returned model, valid Chat Completion
event_hash: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON excluding event_hash, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon; first prev_hash 64 zeroes
